id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying an unlogged table read on a read replica

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a PostgreSQL error classification and user-facing message for SQLSTATE 0A000, potentially preventing infinite retry loops when connecting to read replicas with temporary or unlogged tables.
